narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -7.97 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 84.368-85.363 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 91.989; the first objective pays 0.93R at 82.949.
